newsitem.title: NORWAY: Benor in alliance with Yukong.
newsitem.headline: Benor in alliance with Yukong.

text.p: Norwegian tanker owner Benor Tankers Ltd has formed a revenue sharing pool with Yukong Line Ltd of South Korea composed of four identical 45,000 deadweight tonne product carriers, a statement on the Oslo bourse said on Tuesday.

The vessel's are to be constructed at Halla's Samho shipyard. Two vessels on Yukong's account are due for delivery in the last quarter of 1998, while two vessels on Benor's account are scheduled for delivery in the first quarter of 1999, the statement said.
Upon completion of delivery of all four vessels, they will be put in a pool managed by Yukong and run from Seoul.
Yukong Line is the shipping arm of the Yukong-Sunkyong Group.
"The new vessels will strengthen the mid-range segment of Benors fleet, currently nine units of about 40,000 dwt," the statement said.
Financing for the new ships has not yet been aranged, it said.
At the end of the first quarter, Benor had free cash and readily available drawing facilities of about $35 million. Cash flow in the three-month period was $8.2 million.
